extension.summary: Πρόσθετο ALPHA Player για το Kodi
extension.description: ALPHA live and on-demand broadcasts, Greece and Cyprus
Ζωντανές και on demand υπηρεσίες του ALPHA, Ελλάδα και Κύπρος
extension.disclaimer: This addon offers content available in Greece and Cyprus and is not published nor endorsed by alphatv.gr or alphacyprus.com.cy
Το πρόσθετο αυτό προσφέρει περιεχόμενο διαθέσιμο στην Ελλάδα και την Κύπρο και δεν έχει δημοσιευθεί ούτε εγκριθεί από το alphatv.gr ή το alphacyprus.com.cy
extension.news:
[B]3.0.0[/B] - Complete rework for the new WordPress based alphatv.gr, whose Isobar ajax endpoints no longer exist and whose REST API is disabled - Live, shows, series, news bulletins and article archives rebuilt on the new theme - Complete show/series catalogue from the sitemaps, with season browsing for series - Cyprus indexer rebuilt on the plain Drupal pages - Stream resolution delegated to ResolveURL / the PluginsGR AlphaGR resolver - Added Movies section for Greece and Cyprus with concurrent deep scraping of metadata (cast, director, writer, duration, year, tagline, rating) - Added movie trailer search via scrapetube with select dialog and native YouTube resolution through ResolveURL - Non-blocking page indicator overlay with configurable screen position and margins - Separate bookmarks databases per region (Greece and Cyprus) - 6-hour function caching for movie catalog listings - Modernized stack: tulip 4.x, urldispatcher, netclient, unicache
[B]2.4.0[/B] - Revert of cache change back to traditional get - Bug fixes accross the board - Utilize youtube addon for resolving some videos
[B]2.3.2[/B] - Bug fix
